description: The query the list route GET {base} reads and the envelope it answers with. ListQueryContractE2ETest (exeris-e2e-tests) proves the generated list query, handler, page record, client and OpenAPI document state exactly this; list-query-contract.spec.ts (exeris-codegen-ts) holds the TypeScript service, store and list to the same file. The two builds never run together, so this file is the one place they meet: change it only together with the generated list query.

sort.meaning: one sortable property and a direction; without it rows come in id order

filter.meaning: one equality filter per filterable property: rows whose property equals the value

properties.sortable: @Field(sortable = true), and every field without @Field, of a type in sortableScalarTypes or an enum; never a List field
properties.filterable: @Field(filterable = true) and every field without @Field, of a type in filterableScalarTypes or an enum; and <relationship>Id for every MANY_TO_ONE
properties.enum: a field is an enum when its enumType, else its type, names an enum the processor emitted beside the entities (enum_*.json): by qualified name, else by simple name. A type merely named like an enum is not one
properties.unrecognised: a field whose type is in neither list and names no emitted enum (a record, a value type of the application's own) is neither a sort key nor a filter; a type the repository cannot store (a Map, a Set, BigInteger, LocalTime, Duration, char, an array) fails generation and reaches no list
properties.neverOffered: the primary key (it is the ORDER BY tiebreak only), the owning tenant, the shared-scope field, the audit fields (created and updated at and by), the version and the soft-delete fields, under their declared or canonical names

filterableEnums: an enum field is filterable by its constant's name
refusedWith400: a sort property that is not sortable, or a direction other than asc or desc
a filter value that does not parse as its property's type
a negative page, or a size outside 1..maximum
